_about: The Runpod serverless ladder for the Track P k = 3 probe runs and the Track D E3 runs. One entry per model; benchmarks/runpod/runpod_campaign.py reads it. Every endpoint is the Hub vLLM worker (runpod-workers/worker-vllm v2.29.0, image b7212acc6, vLLM v0.31.0, CUDA 13.0), one GPU, workers 0..1, idle 120 s, 1,800 s job timeout, prefix caching on, MAX_MODEL_LEN 65536. Env keys are the worker's: any UPPERCASED `vllm serve` flag is applied; VLLM_EXTRA_ARGS is appended verbatim. extra_body is sent with every request by the runner (--extra-body) and recorded in run.json. rate_usd_h is the serverless flex rate of the cheapest pool listed (list-gpu-types, 2026-10-16); est_usd is one k = 3 campaign (99 episodes, three repeats on one worker, 4 to 7 h) and is a guess until the first probe runs. endpoint is filled in by `runpod_campaign.py create`. Two keys added 2026-10-28 for the Track D spread (benchmarks/runpod/PLAN.md): `public: true` marks a Runpod public endpoint (Runpod serves the model and bills per token; the account owns no endpoint resource, so create, warm, status, workers and delete refuse it and the route is the same /openai/v1); `trackd_local` names the Track D row the model already has on RobertsPC, and `e3` refuses such a model without --force (Robert, Oct 28: the Runpod spread does not duplicate a model that runs locally). 2026-11-04 (Track D under e3-v3, PLAN.md 'The $100 plan'): the three rungs on that plan carry `trackd_v3` (the runs, in order) and `context` 131072 = their endpoints' MAX_MODEL_LEN, raised from 65,536 on 2026-11-04 (env MAX_MODEL_LEN in the spec, so a `create --again` keeps it) and passed to the harness as --context-tokens; the same day their endpoints' allowedCudaVersions ['13.0'] (an exact set: most hosts now report 13.2) was cleared for a minCudaVersion 13.0 floor. Serverless rates read 2026-11-04: BLACKWELL_96 $3.49, AMPERE_80 $2.72, ADA_80_PRO (H100) $5.39 (was $2.72 on 2026-10-16), AMPERE_48 $1.22, HOPPER_141 $6.99.

glm-5.3.name: GLM-5.3 (Runpod public endpoint)
glm-5.3.label: glm-5.3-runpod-public
glm-5.3.family: Z.ai GLM-5.3 (Oct 2026): the largest open-weight model Track D can reach; Runpod serves it, precision as served (not stated on the listing)
glm-5.3.notes: Read from list-public-endpoints on 2026-10-28 21:40 PDT: endpoint b1dd8hy2hqo1nb, model glm-5.3, owner zai-org, live, 262K context, function calling and JSON output, OpenAI SDK compatible, thinking shown before the answer; $0.77 per 1M input tokens, $0.143 per 1M cached input, $2.42 per 1M output. The route is the ladder's (https://api.runpod.ai/v2/b1dd8hy2hqo1nb/openai/v1) with the same RUNPOD_API_KEY. Per-token billing, so the harness's cumulative input (0.6-1.0M tokens a d1-test episode, each turn resending the transcript) sets the price and Runpod's prompt cache decides it: 100 d1-test episodes are $20-35 if the resent prefix is cached, $50-85 if not; d1-real 1.5x, hard-pilots 2.7M tokens an episode. Sampling: the endpoint's defaults until a smoke says otherwise. Priced in src/roaddraft/eval/prices.json so --cost-cap holds it. e3-smoke first (d1-dev[:5], $1-4) to measure the cached share; no run without Robert's go.
trackd_v3: e3-smoke (d1-dev[:5]): measures the cached share and $ an episode
d1-test under --cost-cap 30, only if the smoke projects 100 episodes at $33 or less

nemotron-3.5-super-vl.notes: 2026-11-11 (Robert: 'drop the GLM and create the nemotron and mistral'): deployed from the Hub (deploy-hub-repo runpod-workers/worker-vllm v2.30.3, template wrtbmhj7x2) and KEPT on the release's own image 9bdc4cefc (vLLM v0.32.0), not the ladder's b7212acc6 (v0.31.0): the card asks for vllm-openai v0.32.0. Serve flags are the card's one-H200 recipe (tensor parallel 1) less the video flags, MTP at 5 draft tokens (the card's RTX PRO 6000 row), 131k context (the ladder's ceiling; the card allows 1M). Sampling and thinking from the card (text: temperature 1.0, top_p 0.95; the card gives 0.6 for vision, not used: one extra_body per run). NVFP4 = a lower precision than the other rows (Robert's OK implied by 'create'). Custom model code (trust remote code). License OpenMDW-1.1. CUDA floor 13.0, idle 600 s, parked at max 0. NEVER RUN: loading on this worker is unproven until its warm job.

Serve flags from the card (mistral tool and reasoning parsers, TRITON_MLA attention, 16384 batched tokens) at tensor parallel 1 (71 GB on a 96 GB card; the card's example uses 2) and 131k context (the ladder's ceiling; the model has 256k). Requests: reasoning_effort high at temperature 0.7 (the card, for complex tasks); the card's SYSTEM_PROMPT.txt is not sent, the harness sends its own. NVFP4 = a lower precision than the other rows. Apache 2.0. CUDA floor 13.0, idle 600 s, parked at max 0. NEVER RUN: loading and tool calls on this worker are unproven until its warm job and smoke.
